apps.localizedDescription:
#### What's Changed:
- **Developer Portal in Settings**: Manage your Apple Developer App IDs, Provisioning Profiles, Certificates, Devices, and App Groups directly inside the app for both paid and free team types.
- **Manual Profile Creation**: Paid developer accounts can now create manual profiles on app without having to reach developer portal.
- **Certificate Management**: Certificate CSR + create/revoke in developer portal, export, import, view all data including ASN1, keys, and much more metadata.
- **Full Two-Factor Authentication**: Added support for SMS verification, Voice phone call in addition to trusted devices during login 2FA Challenge.
- **Cellular Refresh**: Now one can enable cellular refresh with shortcuts to refresh on the go without waiting for wifi anytime anywhere (credits to @spidy123222)
- **Health Check**: Newer dedicated Health Check section in settings to diagnose device and network communication issues quickly.
- **On-Device Anisette**: Switched to on-device anisette data generation as the primary anisette data source of OTP requests during 2FA. No more need for Remote anisette servers.
- **App & Mach-O Inspector**: Inspect any app's internal files, Mach-O binaries, and embedded provisioning profiles right from App Info.
- **Storage Explorer**: Full view of all storage managed by the app and its sideloaded apps including caches, appgroups, tmp dirs, private documents dir etc.
- **Faster VPN peer auto-discovery**: Parallel connection probing discovers your device on the local vpn network much faster by doing a parallel probe for device services like lockdown/rppairing ports.
- **Dual Connection Modes**: Switch between LocalDevVPN/WireGuard and Remote servers as for loopback as required.
- **Account Config Export**: Export and import your accounts and sources as `.sideconf` files for quick setup or migration.
- **Full Liquid-Glass support**: Added smooth pill buttons, improved scroll animations, and fixed UI flickering in the My Apps tab.

#### ⚠️Known Issue
- iOS 16 users may have difficulty connecting to LocalDevVPN and is being actively worked on.

Having a good September? We have been hard at work on stability improvements and better error logging for SideStore!

# Changes 

 * The Unable to install app (aka staging error) error message has been split into explicit error messages. This should allow people who get the error to troubleshoot more easily. (Dadoum for initial implementation, naturecodevoid for fixes)
* AltSign and all other dependencies were updated. This should help fix some issues. (spidy123222 and Joelle Lonkell for AltSign, naturecodevoided for everything else)
* The notification and alert explaining SideStore needing to be in the background to refresh was shortened and made clearer. (spidy123322)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.5.0..0.5.1

Happy May! We have been very busy with doing quality of life changes and fixing bugs everyone’s been having. WE RECOMMEND FRESH INSTALL ON THIS UPDATE. it took this long as there was some problems that were hard and some things needed fixed before releasing and testing, but this should make sidestore much better to use. If you ever want to test sidestore versions use nightly version of sidestore. If you’re into even more experimental join our discord and try our ipas we ask for testing. 

 For people that want to use MDC no3applimit (MacDirtyCow). It’s currently not ready as it includes the patch not needing any external apps. So for any brave people that really want it you will have to look at this pull request and use the ipa downloads from GitHub actions  https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/259 or get it from our site as a ipa labeled MDC.

 What's Changed: 

 - Fix: Fix expire early issue (it will open safari to finish refreshing sidestore now.) 

 - Updated to Anisette V3, this is much better than version 1 as it prevents locking and other anisette issues. 

 - Fix: no provisioning profile with the requested identifier. 

 - Remove jkcoxson anisette server from preferred servers. 

 - Update store check to check for AltServer or SideServer installation 

 - refactor minimuxer to use swift-bridge (#321) 

 - Change the default anisette server 

 - fix: hopefully reduce ApplicationVerificationFailed errors by removing _CodeSignature folders since those may cause a problems. 

 - Fix: 'The name for this app is invalid' error(#361). 

 - Remove app groups that contain AltStore 

 - Change SideStore Anisette server url to use https. Full Commit Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.3.1...0.4.0

#### Full Changelog: [07f0b5ab...5ed10511](https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/07f0b5ab91886031d0fdcead1de609d693e401f7...5ed10511515d6de1bf1e2c7589ca68e3f35ea830)

#### What's Changed:
- **Developer Portal in Settings**: Manage your Apple Developer App IDs, Provisioning Profiles, Certificates, Devices, and App Groups directly inside the app for both paid and free team types.
- **Manual Profile Creation**: Paid developer accounts can now create manual profiles on app without having to reach developer portal.
- **Certificate Management**: Certificate CSR + create/revoke in developer portal, export, import, view all data including ASN1, keys, and much more metadata.
- **Full Two-Factor Authentication**: Added support for SMS verification, Voice phone call in addition to trusted devices during login 2FA Challenge.
- **Cellular Refresh**: Now one can enable cellular refresh with shortcuts to refresh on the go without waiting for wifi anytime anywhere (credits to @spidy123222)
- **Health Check**: Newer dedicated Health Check section in settings to diagnose device and network communication issues quickly.
- **On-Device Anisette**: Switched to on-device anisette data generation as the primary anisette data source of OTP requests during 2FA. No more need for Remote anisette servers.
- **App & Mach-O Inspector**: Inspect any app's internal files, Mach-O binaries, and embedded provisioning profiles right from App Info.
- **Storage Explorer**: Full view of all storage managed by the app and its sideloaded apps including caches, appgroups, tmp dirs, private documents dir etc.
- **Faster VPN peer auto-discovery**: Parallel connection probing discovers your device on the local vpn network much faster by doing a parallel probe for device services like lockdown/rppairing ports.
- **Dual Connection Modes**: Switch between LocalDevVPN/WireGuard and Remote servers as for loopback as required.
- **Account Config Export**: Export and import your accounts and sources as `.sideconf` files for quick setup or migration.
- **Full Liquid-Glass support**: Added smooth pill buttons, improved scroll animations, and fixed UI flickering in the My Apps tab.

#### ⚠️Known Issue
- iOS 16 users may have difficulty connecting to LocalDevVPN and is being actively worked on.
